description: An abstract PHP class defining a base for report filter fields in the OrangeHRM system, including properties, constructor, abstract methods for query modification and entity alias retrieval, and utility methods for property access and modification.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic report filter field with properties for order, coordinates, operator, and abstract methods for query manipulation and obtaining entity aliases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a FilterField with optional operator, coordinates, and order.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to add filtering conditions to a query builder.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entity aliases associated with the filter.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the filter field.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator associated with the filter.

methods.name: modifyX
methods.description: Allows modification of the X value via a callable function.

methods.name: modifyY
methods.description: Allows modification of the Y value via a callable function.
